summary.name: Stremio
summary.one_liner: Stremio is an open-source media center app for watching movies, TV shows, web channels, sports, TV channels and podcasts through installable addons.
use_cases: watch movies and TV shows across devices
play magnet links or torrent files
cast video to a Chromecast or Android TV
install addons to find extra content
continue watching progress on another device
summary.what_it_does:
Stremio is a media center that lets users browse and watch movies, TV shows, web channels, sports, TV channels and podcasts. Content comes from addons the user installs from the addon catalog; the page states Stremio itself provides no content. It can play magnet links, plain HTTP links and torrent files (via drag and drop), and supports 4K HDR. It syncs library and watch progress across devices after login and can cast to Chromecast from desktop and Android apps. The page says the code is open source and addons do not run code locally.</what_it_does>
